issue.body: Due to https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues/10041 we require Harfbuzz as an explicit dependency for the time being. This can't be fixed until vcpkg resolves its own issue first.

body: Looking at https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/pull/9706 vs https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/pull/9888, there are various lines that were explicitly excluding harfbuzz before which weren't added back in 9888.

@tannergooding, thanks for reporting this issue.

PR#9888 remove harfbuzz feature from freetype, due to we already have port harfbuzz which depend on freetype. If not remove that feature, then freetype depend on harfbuzz, harfbuzz depend on freetype, it become circle, and will fail with issue https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues/9850.

The solution here might need to add 'harfbuzz' to the project when it used.
     find_package(harfbuzz CONFIG REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE harfbuzz::harfbuzz)

Sure, but I was pointing out that prior to #9706 (which added the optional support for harfbuzz) FreeType was built with the following two options (always): https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/pull/9706/files#diff-8921d681f7afa53cf4fb11cc2d46aab8L35-L36

After 9706, you could optionally enable it; but that caused the issue reported in https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues/9850 (and no issue if disabled).

In https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/pull/9888, you removed the support for enabling harfbuzz, but didn't add back in the lines that prevented it from building as part of freetype (which looks to be causing the issue @RubyNova logged).

@tannergooding, thanks for clarifying this.

However, I checked the freetype which already disabled harfbuzz by default.  I'm not  sure why it still build here.
 
option(FT_WITH_HARFBUZZ "Improve auto-hinting of OpenType fonts." OFF)

Could you please try to add -DFT_WITH_HARFBUZZ=OFF under 
https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/ports/freetype/portfile.cmake#L39 and see if the issue solve?

@capnkenny, thanks for trying out this!

Would you like to summit a PR? I think only adding '-DCMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_HarfBuzz=TRUE' that should work.

Sure thing!

I'll test only including the one line first, then I'll submit a PR with the change.
